errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are not at regular intervals; it is a logarithmic scale with specific model sizes labeled.
The final value for the Precision (red) line at 7.0B is visibly lower than its starting value of ~78%. It is closer to 76%.
The starting value for the Recall (blue) line at 70m is visibly the lowest of the three lines and appears to be around 8%, not 10%.
